mapper.select: SELECT * FROM nutrition_tips WHERE workout_id = #{workoutId}::uuid ORDER BY CASE timing WHEN 'PRE_WORKOUT'::nutrition_timing_enum THEN 1 WHEN 'POST_WORKOUT'::nutrition_timing_enum THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
